prism.license_summary: Human-written prompts: CC-BY-4.0; model responses: CC-BY-NC-4.0; respect original model-provider terms.
usage_requirements: Research/educational use; do not attempt to identify or deanonymize participants.
Apply PII and moderation metadata before data enters model training or human review.
Do not redistribute downloaded raw data or include it in Git artifacts.
prism.primary_use: user-linked feedback study and synthesis development

usage_requirements: Preserve all five original rating dimensions and ties.
Keep validation labels sealed until the final evaluation.
helpsteer2.primary_use: controlled feedback replay and evaluator calibration

lccc.license_summary: Hugging Face card lists MIT; upstream project states research-only use. Underlying social-media text rights and human-review display conditions require review.
usage_requirements: Review upstream research-only disclaimer and applicable source-data terms before downloading or displaying samples to human reviewers.
Do not redistribute raw data or records containing source dialogue text.
Audit source dialogue text for direct identifiers before generating or displaying derived samples.
Use only the base configuration official train, valid, and test files.
lccc.primary_use: candidate source for a Chinese contextual-continuation task; not real IME interaction data
